title: 第312章 不是天人第311章 无常一族
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 这个冥界，到底是个什么东西？
为什么前世神话故事里的这些玩意儿，一个接一个地往外蹦？
无常少司继续道：“以阁下的实力，确实有足够的资格加入我渡厄司，只不过，司王之位……在下实在做不了主。”
“不如这样，阁下容我回去与司王商议一番，届时再给阁下一个满意的答复。”
陈观脸色一沉。“老子当你是合作伙伴，你是在把老子当傻子耍？”
“想跑就直说，何必找这种借口来侮辱老子的智商？”
鬼面少司连连摇头：“阁下误会了，在下岂敢，这一次……”
“行了！”
陈观直接打断了他，语气骤然冷了下来。
“说说吧，你们盯着这个丫头的真正目的。”
那无常少司脸色瞬间一变。
其实，他之所以放下颜面来服软，就是不想陈观追究这个问题。
因为这个秘密牵涉到传说中的冥府，一个足以撼动整个渡厄司格局的天大秘密。
“阁下，这个……在下其实也不甚清楚，只是遵从司王之令，前来带走这位堕疆后裔，去面见司王而已。”
“呵。”陈观轻笑一声。
这个家伙刚才背了一首好诗，将这死丫头的来历底说条理清晰，现在竟然跟自己说不知道？
陈观直接道：“我对嘴硬之人，有一种特殊的招待方式。”
“不过，这种方式嘛，一直都只存在于我的构思之中，还从未有机会实践。”
他看向无常少司，笑的意味深长。
“今天，刚好找到一个实验品。”
“你！”无常少司心中大感不妙，
他瞬间意识到，这个镖人是要逼问那个秘密！
同时，他的脑中飞速运转，开始重新审视陈观的身份。
“难道此人是来自归墟，同样在谋划冥府之事，而且他并不知道颜宝儿身上的秘密？”
他觉得很有可能，不然他为何要逼问颜宝儿存在的意义？
可，这个秘密太过沉重。
如果他敢说出半个字，不仅是他要死，他身后的整个无常一族，都要从这世间彻底泯灭！
无常少司来不及犹豫，双手一抬，十指间迸射出一缕缕惨白的魂丝，在虚空中交织成一张巨大的魂网，朝着四面八方铺天盖地地撒下！
【摄魂引渡】！
嗡！
一股无形的力量瞬间笼罩整片战场。
他身后那数千战将，那些飘荡着死气的阴魂，包括那六位诡族老祖——所有人身体猛地一僵，整个人定在原地，如同泥塑木雕。
细看之下，一缕缕几近透明的魂魄，正从他们的天灵盖中被缓缓抽离！
紧接着，无常少司猛地抬手一甩，道魂丝瞬间凝结成一条漆黑锁链。
锁链通体乌黑，每一环上都刻满密密麻麻的古老符文，环绕着一道道渗人幽光。
“我去，这是勾魂锁？！”
陈观忍不住惊呼出声。
“嗯？！”无常少司闻言，心中猛然一沉。
果然被自己猜中了！
这个家伙就是来自玄荒！
不然他不可能连无常一族的本命神通都知道的这么清楚！
容不得他多想，手中那漆黑锁一甩，化作一条择人黑蛇，朝着陈观缠绕而去！

What is this underworld?
Why do these things from the myths and stories of past lives pop out one after another?
Wuchang Shaosi continued: "With your strength, you are indeed qualified enough to join our Du'es Division. However, as the Si King... I really can't make the decision."
"How about this? Your Excellency, please allow me to go back and discuss with King Si, and then I will give you a satisfactory answer."
Chen Guan's face darkened. "I treat you as a partner, are you treating me like a fool?"
"If you want to run away, just say so. Why do you need to find this excuse to insult my intelligence?"
Ghost Face Shaosi shook his head repeatedly: "Your Excellency has misunderstood, how dare I, this time..."
"Okay!"
Chen Guan interrupted him directly, and his tone suddenly became cold.
"Tell me, your real purpose behind staring at this girl."
"This..."
The Wuchang Shaosi's expression changed instantly.
In fact, the reason why he put down his face and surrendered was because he didn't want Chen Guan to pursue this issue.
Because this secret involves the legendary Hades, a huge secret that can shake the entire structure of Duesi.
"Your Excellency, I actually don't know much about this. I just followed the order of the King of Si and came to take away this descendant of the Fallen Frontier to meet the King of Si."
"Ha." Chen Guan chuckled.
This guy just recited a good poem and explained the origin of this dead girl in a clear and logical manner, and now he is telling himself that he doesn't know?
Chen Guan said directly: "I have a special way of entertaining people who are harsh."
"However, this method has always only existed in my conception, and I have never had the opportunity to put it into practice."
He looked at Wuchang Shaosi and smiled meaningfully.
"Today, I just found an experimental subject."
"You!" Wuchang Shaosi felt something bad in his heart.
He instantly realized that this escort wanted to ask for the secret!
At the same time, his mind was racing and he began to re-examine Chen Guan's identity.
"Could it be that this person is from Guixu and is also planning things in the underworld, and he doesn't know the secrets about Yan Baoer?"
He thought it was very possible, otherwise why would he ask Yan Baoer about the meaning of his existence?
However, this secret is too heavy.
If he dares to say even a word, not only will he die, but the entire Impermanence clan behind him will be completely wiped out from this world!
Wuchang Shaosi had no time to hesitate. He raised his hands and shot out wisps of pale soul threads from his fingers. They intertwined into a huge soul net in the void and spread in all directions!
[Soul-taking Extradition]!
Buzz!
An invisible force instantly enveloped the entire battlefield.
The thousands of generals behind him, those ghosts with deathly aura, including the six ancestors of the Wei clan - all of them suddenly stiffened, and their whole bodies were frozen in place, like clay and wood sculptures.
Upon closer inspection, wisps of almost transparent souls were slowly being pulled out of their Heavenly Spirit Caps!
Immediately afterwards, Wuchang Shaosi suddenly raised his hand and flicked it, and the Tao Soul Silk instantly condensed into a dark chain.
The chain is completely black, and each link is engraved with densely packed ancient runes, surrounded by streaks of penetrating light.
"Here I go, is this a soul hook?!"
Chen Guan couldn't help but exclaimed.
"Huh?!" Wuchang Shaosi heard this, and his heart suddenly sank.
Sure enough, I guessed it right!
This guy comes from Xuanhuang!
Otherwise, it would be impossible for him to know so clearly the natal magical powers of the Impermanence clan!
Not allowing him to think too much, he flicked the pitch-black lock in his hand and turned into a black snake that chose others, winding towards Chen Guan!
